SELECT * FROM
where 1 = 1
and alarm_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and conf_mode = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and device_name like concat("%",#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%") and mete_name like concat("%",#{meteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%") and alarm_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
AND (CASE WHEN #{alarmSource, jdbcType=INTEGER} = 888 THEN alarm_source = 888 WHEN #{alarmSource, jdbcType=INTEGER} = 279 THEN alarm_source = 279 WHEN #{alarmSource, jdbcType=INTEGER} != 279 and #{alarmSource, jdbcType=INTEGER} != 888 THEN alarm_source != 888 and alarm_source != 279 END) ORDER BY alarm_time DESC

SELECT a.countNum as device, b.countNum as robot, d.countNum as camera, (a.countNum+b.countNum+d.countNum) as total FROM( (select count(*) as countNum from t_warn_info ) a, (select count(*) as countNum from t_robot_alarm ) b, (select count(*) as countNum from t_camera_alarm) d )

select dict_code as device_type, dict_note as device_type_name, (select COUNT(*) from t_std_device a,t_warn_info b where a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.cunstom_id and device_type = dict_code and b.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) as c_ount from t_dict_business where dict_code in ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'device_type' ) ORDER BY c_ount desc

select dict_code as device_type, dict_note as device_type_name, ( (select COUNT(*) from t_std_device a,t_warn_info b where a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.cunstom_id and device_type = dict_code and b.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) + (select COUNT(*) from t_std_device a,t_defect_info b where a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.cunstom_id and device_type = dict_code and b.defect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) ) as c_ount from t_dict_business where dict_code in ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'device_type' ) ORDER BY c_ount desc

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ac-1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') as timeNode FROM ( SELECT @ai:=@ai+1 as ac from (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) ac1, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6) ac2, (SELECT @ai:=0) xc0 ) c )a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(warn_time) date, warn_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_warn_info WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), warn_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ac-1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') as timeNode FROM ( SELECT @ai:=@ai+1 as ac from (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) ac1, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6) ac2, (SELECT @ai:=0) xc0 ) c )a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(defect_time) date, defect_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_defect_info WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), defect_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (select date_add(curdate(), interval(cast(help_topic_id as signed ) - 30) day) timeNode from mysql.help_topic where help_topic_id < day(last_day(curdate())) order by help_topic_id) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(warn_time) date, warn_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_warn_info WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), warn_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ac-1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') as timeNode FROM ( SELECT @ai:=@ai+1 as ac from (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) ac1, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6) ac2, (SELECT @ai:=0) xc0 ) c )a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(alarm_time) date, alarm_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_robot_alarm WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), alarm_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

SELECT a.processed as '已核查', e.untreated as '未核查' FROM ( (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_warn_info where warn_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) a, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_warn_info where warn_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) e )

SELECT a.processed + b.processed as '已核查', d.untreated + e.untreated as '未核查' FROM ( (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_warn_info where warn_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) a, (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_defect_info where defect_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) b, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_warn_info where warn_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) d, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_defect_info where defect_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) e )

SELECT ( a.countNum + b.countNum ) AS total FROM ( ( SELECT count(*) AS countNum FROM t_warn_info WHERE conf_mode = 276 ) a, ( SELECT count(*) AS countNum FROM t_defect_info WHERE conf_mode = 276 ) b )

SELECT a.warn_id, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.instance_id, h.cruise_id as presetId, k.camera_id, a.warn_time as alarm_time, a.std_mete_id, d.mete_name, a.warn_level as alarm_level, e.dict_note as alarm_level_name, a.warn_content, g.real_code, a.image_path, a.alarm_source, f.dict_note as alarm_source_name, a.defect_model, m.dict_note as defect_model_name, b.custom_name FROM t_warn_info a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.cunstom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete d on a.std_mete_id = d.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e on e.dict_code = a.warn_level and e.col_name = 'alarm_level' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f on f.dict_code = a.alarm_source and f.col_name = 'alarm_source' LEFT JOIN t_std_device_attr g on g.device_id = a.device_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance h on h.instance_id = a.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset k on k.preset_id = h.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business m on m.dict_code = a.defect_model and m.col_name = 'defect_model' where 1 = 1 and warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT a.dict_note FROM t_dict_business a WHERE 1 = 1 and a.dict_code = #{dictCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.col_name = #{colName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.mete_name, b.device_name, d.real_code, b.custom_name FROM t_std_devicemete a, t_std_device b, t_std_device_attr d WHERE 1 = 1 and a.device_mete_id = #{stdMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.custom_id and a.device_id = d.device_id
SELECT a.cruise_id as presetId FROM t_cruise_point_instance a WHERE 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT k.camera_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset k on k.preset_id = a.cruise_id WHERE 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
